verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit explicitly supports pushing back via chat (challenge recommendations) and has a dedicated 'learnings' feature that teaches CodeRabbit review preferences via natural-language chat so it doesn't repeat rejected feedback, reinforced by path instructions and org-wide config for persistent preferences. Community evidence corroborates good review quality (comm-1, comm-6) though some users found it verbose/false-positive prone (comm-2), which is a quality caveat but doesn't concretely contradict the learning mechanism itself. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that a specific rejected comment is concretely never repeated, and more detail on how durable/scoped the learning is across PRs.
